text.text: I turn mixed-methods data into product insights that drive behavior change, across UX research, product strategy, and growth and lifecycle work. I pair quantitative patterns with direct user feedback to find where something breaks down, then build the product change that fixes it.

My public health background shapes how I read that data. It trained me to look past the individual pain point to the system causing it, and to combine quantitative patterns with the qualitative why behind them. I bring that lens to consumer health, travel, and subscription products.
I'm also a hands-on builder. I use Claude Code and Cowork to prototype product changes, build data models, and test ideas directly rather than only speccing them.
I'm open to conversations about UX research, product strategy, and growth and lifecycle roles, particularly in consumer health, travel, and subscription products.
Columbia University · Master of Public Health (MPH)

I'm looking for UX research, product strategy, or growth and lifecycle roles in consumer health, travel tech, or subscription products. Currently based in California, open to relocating to SoCal. Prefer in-person, open to remote.
